verdict.rationale: Steel documents an automatic CAPTCHA solving stance: a dedicated captcha-solving docs page says one session flag covers detection, solving and verification, and there is a Captchas API for managing them. Separately, a debug-URL human-in-the-loop feature gives a plausible manual fallback. Missing for 10: documentation of what happens when solving fails (error or status signaling rather than silent failure), human fallback explicitly tied to CAPTCHA handling, and independent or hands-on corroboration of solving reliability.
